Headquarters: Remote - Germany

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role 

We are looking for an Account Executive, Commercial to join our team in Berlin reporting to the Sales Director in the Sales and Go-to-Market department. You will drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future by managing a territory focused on net new logo and up-sell opportunities for accounts with 750 to 5,000 users. Your focus is on building high-impact business cases that demonstrate clear value and differentiation across all levels of prospect organizations.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Own an assigned territory with a focus on capturing net new logos and driving up-sell opportunities within the 750 to 5,000 user segment

• Develop and present comprehensive business cases that articulate clear value and differentiation to stakeholders at all levels

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Transformation teams to navigate complex sales cycles

• Drive consistent pipeline generation through innovative techniques, field marketing initiatives, and strategic engagement with top-tier channel partners

• Maintain high accountability for sales targets while leveraging internal resources and partners to ensure customer success

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• Minimum 3 years of sales experience with a revenue quota selling to commercial accounts in the German market

• Proven history of over-achievement in net new logo acquisition and a deep understanding of how to leverage channel partnerships

• Strong discipline to execute a proven sales process from start to finish alongside a coachable mindset

• Demonstrated ability to succeed in a "team sales" environment by effectively utilizing internal and partner resources

• Professional fluency in German

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience leveraging AI-driven conversational intelligence or predictive analytics tools to optimize commercial territory planning and accelerate deal velocity

• Direct experience selling security, SaaS, or enterprise software solutions

• Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field of study

Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.  Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.
About the role

MetaMask is building the infrastructure for a decentralised web. Our TechOps team keeps that infrastructure running — reliably, securely, and at scale. As a Senior Systems Administrator, you'll own the technical backbone that our engineers, product teams, and operations depend on every day.

You'll work across cloud and SaaS environments, driving improvements that raise the bar on system reliability and operational maturity. You'll be expected to bring judgment, initiative, and technical depth — and to operate with significant autonomy.

As a member of the TechOps team, you will drive the operational reliability of the technical ecosystems utilized by our global workforce. Beyond day-to-day administration, you will spearhead high-impact infrastructure initiatives that define our organizational maturity and technical trajectory. As the main IT point of contact for our employees, you will also assist with technical projects as we scale various teams.

What you'll do

• Ticket management and remote support

• Hardware and software support

• Networking

• Videoconferencing (both digital and physical)

• Onboarding and offboarding tasks for new hires and departing employees

• Procuring and shipping equipment to remote employees across the EU

• General technical assistance

• Execution of large-scale technical projects and company-wide technology initiatives

• Work as part of the team responsible for the administration, performance, and reliability of cloud infrastructure across multiple environments, including Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom and Atlassian

• Manage and evolve hybrid systems, ensuring seamless integration with cloud workloads

• Administer and optimise the SaaS and MDM tooling stack that supports a globally distributed workforce

• Lead incident response for critical systems, including root cause analysis and post-incident review

• Build and maintain automation to reduce manual overhead and improve system observability

• Define and enforce security and access control policies across platforms

• Partner with the Security teams to support compliance requirements

• Contribute to technical documentation and runbooks that raise team-wide operational standards

What you'll bring

• 5+ years in systems administration or infrastructure engineering roles

• Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure environments

• Experience administering enterprise SaaS platforms and MDM solutions (e.g. Jumpcloud, Okta)

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, identity management, and access control

• Track record of operating autonomously and making sound technical decisions under pressure

• Clear communicator — able to translate technical complexity for non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

• Experience in a web3, fintech, or high-growth tech environment

• Exposure to security frameworks or compliance programmes (SOC2, ISO 27001)

• Experience supporting globally distributed, fully remote teams

• Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure)

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.
US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
$138,745—$202,336 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Headquarters: US - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 

About the Role:

You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. As a Senior Customer Success Manager at Wrike, you will own, protect, and exponentially grow the strategic relationship for a high-value portfolio of Enterprise accounts across North America. Wrike has evolved beyond standard project management into a trusted work delivery platform for people and AI, and in this role, you will be the chief architect of that vision for our most strategic clients.

In this role, you are a strategic business consultant and a trusted advisor. You will guide client executives through complex business transformations, leveraging cutting-edge Wrike AI Agents, Wrike Copilot, and visual collaboration tools to map, optimize, and scale business workflows. You will partner deeply with Sales, Renewals, and Product counterparts to deliver on the transformational vision and establish Wrike as the clients' long-term operating system of record.

Your Impact:

• Strategic Portfolio Ownership: Proactively manage a highly diverse and complex book of North American Enterprise accounts, serving as their strategic partner, executive liaison, and primary advocate.

• Build Stakeholder Relationships: Establish a multi-layered relationship structure - including Centers of Excellence - connecting with administrators, day-to-day champions, and executive-level sponsors (VPs, C-suite).

• Co-Create Success Plans & Workflows: Build scalable and highly digestible Success Plans that capture the client's transformational vision and a measurable roadmap to build it out.

• Play Offense: Actively hunt for expansion paths within your portfolio. You will not wait for renewals to talk about growth; instead, you will proactively identify new teams to land, pitch advanced AI use cases, and systematically build a high-velocity expansion pipeline in lockstep with Sales.

• Commercial Growth & Retention: Meet individual Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets by proactively identifying expansion opportunities, mapping customer growth plans, and mitigating churn risks early.

• Operational Excellence: You will continuously iterate on processes, develop new workflow playbooks, and share documented learnings across the broader organization.

Your Qualifications:

• Proven GTM Track Record: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Business Consulting roles within the SaaS space, with a verified track record of managing $100K+ ARR accounts.

• Change Management & COE Mastery: Proven expertise in guiding large-scale organizations through complex software rollouts and operational transformations by mapping and navigating stakeholder management and building internal Centers of Excellence (COEs).

• Executive Presence & Storytelling: Highly polished communication skills with a proven capability to establish radical trust, navigate political dynamics, and present quantified business value/ROI to C-suite and VP-level technology leaders.

• Commercial Acumen & C-Suite Framing: A proven history of partnering with Sales to build joint account plans, identify upsell opportunities, and guide customers through complex buying cycles. You possess a deep understanding of enterprise procurement processes and are highly skilled at framing the business and operational value of a product to C-level audiences, translating technical features into hard cost savings, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency.

• Workflow Consulting Expertise: Ability to run structured, outcome-led Workflow Discoveries and reverse demos to help customers work collaboratively across dispersed organizations and recommend best practices.

• Technical & Integration Literacy: Strong comfort with tech ecosystems; ability to discuss complex system integrations, data analytics, and address technical hurdles (such as API webhooks or integration recipes) in lockstep with supporting teams.

• AI-Enabled Capability: Strong literacy and hands-on experience embedding practical Generative AI tools into daily operations.

Standout Qualities:

• Vertical Specialization: You have deep domain expertise in one or more core industry verticals (e.g., Marketing, Creative Agencies, PMOs) and can build reusable workflow playbooks for the team.

• Certified Change Management Coach: You have experience guiding organizations through large-scale software rollouts and operational change management.

• Certified Project Manager: You hold a recognized industry certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum) and possess a formal understanding of project management methodologies to easily translate complex client workflows into structured, high-performing configurations.

• Peer Mentor: You naturally seek opportunities to mentor junior team members, share best practices, and contribute to the collective enablement of the Customer Success organization.

• Utilize Digital Campaign: You have the ability to leverage digital campaigns to target new contacts and opportunities.

Team Dynamics:

You will join a high-performing, collaborative North American Customer Success team that values transparency, continuous learning, and collective growth. We work cross-functionally, sharing insights across Sales, Product, Renewals, and Support to ensure our customers have a unified experience. As a senior member of this team, you will play a key role in running internal enablement sessions and shaping best practices.

Our Work Style:

At Wrike, we believe in proactive ownership, data-driven decisions, and a growth mindset. We leverage Wrike every day to manage our own work, collaborate seamlessly across time zones, and maintain operational transparency. We embrace change, continuously seek feedback, and empower our team members to work smart, innovate, and bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Benefits & Perks:

• Flexible Time Off (FTO)

• Company 401(k) Match

• Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity

• 2 Volunteer Days

• Health (medical, dental & vision) Insurance (EEs + Dependents)

• Disability (STD, LTD) & Life Insurance Plans (2x Salary, Capped)

• Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)

• $500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend

Your recruitment buddy will be Aziza Talhi, Senior Recruiter.

Hi,
This is Sakshi from Aquilasys Inc.
 
I am reaching out regarding an immediate, high-impact career opportunity for a Senior Business Analyst (Corporate Treasury & Financial Analytics) supporting our enterprise fintech and asset management client based in Pune. 
Given your background (8+ years overall, with 5+ years dedicated to financial reporting and data analytics), along with your exposure to Fintech, Asset Management, Capital Markets (Equities/Fixed Income), and Agile/Scrum delivery, your profile stands out as an exceptional fit for this team.
 
Position Details
Role: Senior Business Analyst Corporate Treasury & Financial Analytics
Location: Pune, Maharashtra
Work Setup: Hybrid Model (3 Days Office / 2 Days Work from Home)

Experience Required:
8+ Years of total professional experience.
Minimum 5+ Years of dedicated experience delivering reporting and analytical data solutions for business teams.
Domain Context: Corporate Treasury, Fintech, Asset Management, Equities Trading, Fixed Income Instruments, Issuer Communications
Delivery Framework: Agile / Scrum (Facilitating and participating in Scrum ceremonies)
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
Position Overview
In this senior consultative role, you will bridge the gap between business stakeholders in Corporate Treasury and cross-functional technical teams. You will perform deep financial data analysis, suggest robust data modeling frameworks, build intuitive executive dashboards, and identify actionable metrics that guide liquidity, funding, and treasury management decisions. Additionally, you will champion business process automation, leverage modernization technologies to shorten financial close and operational cycles, and facilitate Scrum events to ensure transparent sprint delivery.
 
Key Responsibilities
Financial Data Analysis & Modeling: Execute in-depth data analysis across complex corporate treasury and capital markets datasets; formulate data modeling recommendations to optimize financial reporting structures.
Dashboard Design & Visualization: Conceptualize, build, and maintain intuitive executive dashboards and visualizations tailored for Corporate Treasury and finance leadership.
Trend & Decision Analytics: Uncover underlying trends, anomalies, and critical performance metrics across cash, liquidity, equities trading, and fixed income portfolios to empower strategic business decisions.
Process Modernization & Automation: Identify manual bottlenecks across monthly/quarterly business cycles; ideate and deliver automation and modernization initiatives that reduce turnaround times and enhance operational efficiency.
Agile Governance & Scrum Events: Actively participate in and manage Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives) within a fast-paced product engineering environment.
Global & Cross-Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with data engineers, software architects, and distributed global stakeholders to execute time-critical financial close cycles and delivery milestones.
Qualifications & Sourcing Criteria
Must-Have:
Total Tenure: 8+ years of total IT/ITES/Consulting experience with at least 5+ years in business analysis, data analytics, and reporting solutions.
Domain Mastery: Practical familiarity with Corporate Treasury, Fintech, Asset Management, or Capital Markets (Equities Trading, Fixed Income Instruments, Cash/Liquidity Management).
Technical & Analytics Acumen:
Demonstrated track record of translating complex financial business requirements into analytical specifications and data models.
Practical experience designing intuitive executive dashboards using modern BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent visualization platforms).
Strong SQL skills and familiarity with relational/dimensional financial data schemas.
Agile Fluency: Hands-on experience working in Scrum environments and facilitating/managing Scrum events.
Work Model & Schedule Fit: Full willingness to work in a Hybrid setup (3 days office / 2 days WFH) in Pune supporting 01:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST shift hours.
Preferred / Desired:
Educational background in Finance, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or Commerce (MBA / M.Tech / B.Tech / B.Com).
Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or Certified Scrum Master (CSM/PSM).
Prior exposure to process automation tools (Python scripting, Alteryx, RPA, or workflow orchestration engines).
 
If you are interested, please reply with your updated resume, current location, current fixed CTC, expected CTC, and official notice period / last working date.

7e4f6c1dbd3ed336.description:
Constantinople delivers a new era of AI-native banking. Constantinople provides banks with a fully-managed software and AI operational platform, which brings together customer experience, product, data, operations, compliance and infrastructure in a single platform.

Constantinople’s AI-native platform eliminates the need for expensive infrastructure, and replaces manual operational and compliance processes with AI at scale. By removing the operational complexity of banking, Constantinople enables our client banks to focus on their customers and the business of banking.

The Role

As a Senior Analytics Engineer at Constantinople, you will design, build, and maintain the data models and transformation pipelines that power client reporting, regulatory reporting, and analytics across the business. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Risk, Finance, and Client Delivery to turn raw platform data into clean, well-modelled datasets the whole company can rely on, using dbt and Snowflake as the backbone of our analytics stack. We are a small team, so you will own meaningful pieces of work end to end and help set the standard for how we build.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and maintain dbt models that transform raw data into clean, well-documented, analysis-ready datasets
• Write and optimise SQL in Snowflake, keeping models performant and cost-efficient as data volumes grow
• Own data quality within your models by implementing tests, documentation, and validation checks that catch issues before they reach downstream consumers
• Partner with Product, Risk, Finance, and Client Delivery to understand reporting needs and turn them into reusable data models rather than one-off queries
• Support and troubleshoot data issues affecting live customer reporting, including taking part in an on-call rotation
• Support the delivery of key metrics used in board, client, and regulatory reporting, where getting the numbers right matters
• Help maintain and evolve our modelling standards, naming conventions, and dbt project structure as the business grows
• Work with data and platform engineers on upstream pipelines, flagging data quality or structural issues at the source
• Take part in code reviews and help improve model quality, testing, and maintainability across the team

Who You Are

• You have hands-on experience building and maintaining data models in dbt, including tests and documentation
• You have strong SQL skills, with experience writing and optimising queries in Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse
• You have a solid understanding of data modelling concepts such as dimensional modelling and star schemas, and can apply them to messy real-world data
• You have worked with an orchestration tool such as Airflow to schedule and monitor pipelines
• You communicate well and are comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand what they need
• You are detail-oriented and care about data quality, with a habit of catching issues before they become someone else's problem
• You are comfortable in a fast-paced start-up environment, pragmatic about scope and sequencing, and careful with data that people make decisions on

Application Process

If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been looking for, select the 'Apply Now' button below to submit your cover letter and resume. Use your cover letter to introduce us to you; we want to know who you are, what you've worked on and why you think you'd be a great addition to the Constantinople team.

Inclusion

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us. Job Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India Employment Type: Full-time Experience Required: 8+ years Salary: 20L36L a year About Turing Enterprises, Inc. We are a global leader in commercial real estate services and investment, advising owners, investors, and occupiers across every stage of the property lifecycle. With decades of expertise spanning leasing, capital markets, valuations, and property management, we are known for the scale and quality of our data, the depth of our market insight, and our commitment to putting reliable information in the hands of our clients and our people. Job Details A large and growing volume of data is flowing into our system of record. Today it sits in a queue for manual review before it is approved and merged, and the team is working toward an agentic framework that can automate parts of this review over time. About the Role We are looking for a Business / Product Analyst who understands data from a business perspective, not a Data Engineer or Data Architect. Qualifications This role is ideal for someone who can look at a schema independently, understand the underlying business entities, and proactively surface patterns and issues, rather than waiting to be told which fields or metrics to pull. The ideal candidate has experience exploring large, imperfect datasets, is comfortable with SQL and exploratory data analysis, and can partner with existing engineers and visualization developers for the technical build-out. What Youll Do Partner with Delivery leadership and existing engineers to understand the data schema, key business entities, and current review process. Analyze current-state data quality involving: Coverage and completion by field, entity type, and asset class Cross-source data conflicts (e.g. one source showing a property's net rentable area as 1M sq ft, while another source records a lease of 1.2M sq ft against that same property) Exceptions and anomalies that fall outside expected patterns Translate business requirements and findings into: Clusters and flags that group related data issues into repeatable patterns Clear visuals and summaries for business and technical stakeholders Rules defining what should route to human review vs. what can be auto-corrected Business process flows User stories Acceptance criteria Data requirements Facilitate working sessions with business and technical stakeholders to validate findings and priorities. Work to query and visualize data, writing basic queries themselves and relying on the broader team for heavier technical lifting. Maintain traceability between identified data issues, the rules they generate, and the resulting workflow behavior. Document data quality findings and recommend improvements to strengthen coverage and reduce manual review effort. Use AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, etc.) to accelerate documentation, analysis, summarization, and research while validating outputs for accuracy and compliance. What We're Looking For 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Data/Functional Analyst delivering data quality, data governance, or data onboarding work. Excellent requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder management skills. Experience with the following: Data coverage or completeness analysis Data reconciliation or conflict resolution across sources Exploratory data analysis and clustering Data quality reporting or dashboarding Working SQL skills, comfortable enough to query and explore data directly. Comfortable working with engineers and discussing: Schemas and data models Query logic and basic data flows Visualization tooling Strong analytical thinking with the ability to identify data gaps and operational risk. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently to scope and selfdirect analysis, rather than needing fully specified requirements. Nice to Have Domain familiarity with real estate, lease, or asset data. Experience supporting data onboarding, master data management, or system-of-record migration efforts. Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies. Exposure to the design or use of agentic / AI-driven workflows for data review and automation. .

7e8f999cec5fe1a1.description:
About CircuitHub
CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.
We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.
The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.
Overview
• 
CircuitHub is primarily built using a combination of Haskell, Nix, and PostgreSQL, deployed to both AWS and bare metal machines. We use a significant amount of open-source technology, and also try and give back where possible (for example, both Rel8 and Fast Downward Haskell bindings).
• 
CircuitHub spans a vast problem space. Challenges include computer vision (OpenCV), machine learning (PyTorch), hard optimization problems (Z3/MiniZinc/OR-Tools), and all the normal engineering challenges of building both web-based customer-facing and internal tooling.
• 
We work on manufacturing execution systems, enterprise resource planning, and robotics. An old video from Haskell Exchange 2019 hints at what we are up to on the robotics side. We have progressed significantly since then!
• 
These roles are remote (any location), in-person, or hybrid, depending on preference.
• 
We have offices in South Deerfield - USA, Cambridge, and London, UK.
• 
Salary depends on the candidate and location, but as guidance in the UK, a likely range is £80k to £125k and in the US $125k to $250k, with additional equity.
• 
CircuitHub has raised $45M from top-tier VCs and has been going for about ten years. CircuitHub is profitable, with tens of millions in revenue. Small team (CircuitHub is ~50 employees) with tremendous growth opportunity and low risk. We are aiming to 10x capacity through 2027 in both our existing Massachusetts factory and expand into Europe.
 
Team/Environment/Role
Our R&D team is more than 20 people, with eight engineers working directly on the Haskell code base. We are looking to expand the team significantly this year. We have many exciting problems to solve, from robotic path planning to more conventional web products.
We are happy to consider candidates without commercial Haskell experience, but your other skills and experience would need to compensate. A possible profile, for instance, would be a professional robotics background with some hobbyist FP experience.
Conversely, for experienced Haskellers without experience in our domain, we will look for interests that correlate with what we are trying to accomplish. Life is too short to work on something you are not passionate about!
 
Location
Work remotely, or from one of our offices in the UK (London, Cambridge) or USA (Boston)
Compensation: £80K – £125K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges
• UK • £80K – £125K • Offers Equity
• US • $125K – $250K • Offers Equity

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll help customers succeed with the Figma product suite, from individual designers to large enterprise teams. You’ll join an experienced, close-knit support team that cares about each other and about doing great work for customers. AI is changing how people design and build, and our products are changing with it. You’ll be among the first to see how customers use what we ship, you’ll learn directly from our Product and Engineering teams, and what you hear from customers will help shape what we build next.

This is a full-time role based in our Bengaluru office.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Resolve customer tickets in Zendesk, mostly by email, such as helping a designer get back into a locked account or sorting out who can view and edit a shared file
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across the Figma product suite, such as figuring out why a prototype isn’t behaving as expected or why a customer’s AI tool won’t connect to Figma
  • Review AI-generated output and credit usage to make fair, consistent calls, such as deciding whether a customer’s AI credit usage matches what they were charged and explaining the outcome clearly
  • Write clear bug reports and product feedback, such as documenting the steps to reproduce an issue affecting several customers so Engineering can prioritize a fix
  • Facilitate calls with customers when email isn’t enough, such as screen-sharing with an Org admin to walk them through their team’s setup
  • Stay current as our products evolve, such as joining a launch session with Product Managers and Engineers, then turning what you learned into a guide or macro for the team
  • Work from our Bengaluru office during a schedule that aligns with US business hours (9:30 PM - 6:30 AM IST)

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 2+ years in a customer support role, ideally at a SaaS company
  • Hands-on experience with design tools like Figma, and regular use of AI tools in your work
  • A knack for technical troubleshooting and explaining complex things simply
  • Excellent written English and a warm, human communication style
  • Curiosity and a habit of learning new technology on your own

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Professional experience in UX or product design
  • Familiarity with AI design or code-generation tools
  • Working knowledge of Zendesk
  • Background in supporting both self-serve and enterprise customers

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.
